chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥajjāl, from Thaʿlabah, from Maʿmar ibn Yaḥyā, who said:

I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a menstruating woman who becomes pure at the time of ʿaṣr: does she pray the first one? He said: No. She only prays the salat (prayer) at whose time she becomes pure.

key_terms.الْأُولَى: the earlier prayer, meaning the preceding salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْعَصْرِ: the time of the ʿaṣr prayer

ai.seo_question: If a menstruating woman becomes pure at the time of ʿaṣr, must she also pray ẓuhr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman who becomes pure at the time of ʿaṣr. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that she does not perform the earlier salat (prayer), but rather only the salat (prayer) whose time is current when her purity begins.
